author: CheekyLizard
body:
Hey guys,
I just got banned for 3 days for "spamming"
I did not spam. I promise. I just said "hey guys, come to hub" twice.
I said it TWICE and got temp banned! for 4 days!!!
I'm not happy and am really sorry. I really didn't mean to spam, I only said something twice.
Please can I be allowed to come back on early rather than waiting 3 days?

Kind Regards,
CheekyLizard.
